messages.subject: Snowflake RODBC Crashes Shiny Server
parts:
Hello,
  I'm getting an error similar to this one:

https://stackoverflow.com/questions/34316243/rodbc-query-brings-down-shiny-server

I installed the Snowflake ODBC driver on the ubuntu linux machine that shiny server is running on.

https://docs.snowflake.net/manuals/user-guide/odbc.html

Here are my shiny files. The code below works with a connection to a SQL Server DB on shiny server. The same code below works when you run the app locally in RStudio. 

My R version is 3.4.1. My shiny version is 1.0.5. My RODBC version is 1.3-15. The VM is using Ubuntu Linux 16.04.

Can someone please help?

thanks,

Huang



server.R
-----------
library(shiny)
library(RODBC)

myServer <- "myserver.snowflakecomputing.com"
myUser <- "myuser"
myPassword <- "mypassword"
myDatabase <- "mydb"
myDriver <- "SnowflakeDSIIDriver" 

connectionString <- paste0(
  "Driver=", myDriver, 
  ";Server=", myServer, 
  ";Database=", myDatabase, 
  ";Uid=", myUser, 
  ";Pwd=", myPassword)

conn <- odbcDriverConnect(connectionString)
close(conn) # don't leak connections !

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$distPlot <- renderPlot({
    hist(c(1, 4, 9), col = 'darkgray', border = 'white')
  })
}



ui.R
-----
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  mainPanel(plotOutput("distPlot"))
)
